headline.title: Ransomware shuts down Vicksburg’s city computers
headline.quip: The city promised no late fees and no shut-offs while its systems were down: the most generous thing ransomware has ever done for a utility customer.
headline.summary: A ransomware attack forced Vicksburg, Mississippi, to temporarily shut down city computer systems, according to Mayor Willis Thompson. 911, police and fire services weren’t affected. In-person utility payments could be delayed, and the city said it wouldn’t charge penalties or cut off service while systems were down.
